# SRA Explorer NG

> SRA Explorer NG is an open-source web application for searching NCBI Sequence Read Archive records and generating reproducible batch-download commands.

Canonical URL: https://sra.ai2paper.com/
Documentation: https://sra.ai2paper.com/docs
OpenAPI: https://sra.ai2paper.com/api/v1/openapi.json
Remote MCP endpoint: https://sra.ai2paper.com/mcp
License: GNU GPL v2
Maintainer: Junhao Chen

## Capabilities

- Search NCBI SRA accessions, studies, projects, and text terms in explicit batches of 500 NCBI records.
- Retrieve ENA FASTQ, normalized SRA, and NCBI Original submitted files.
- Preserve instrument-native submissions such as Oxford Nanopore FAST5/POD5 when submitters deposited them.
- Generate collection-level curl, axel, fastq-dl, Kingfisher, AWS CLI, MD5 verification, rename, and project-directory commands.
- Export sample-level TSV, JSON, YAML, URL manifests, and Bash scripts.
- Expose read-only JSON API and MCP tools for software agents.

## Data provenance

Search metadata comes from NCBI E-utilities. Original submitted file metadata comes from the NCBI Run Browser. FASTQ metadata comes from the ENA Portal API. Availability and file formats depend on the original submitter and archive.

## Important distinction

FASTQ and normalized SRA are not substitutes for instrument-native signal data. For analyses that require raw Nanopore signal, use Original submitted FAST5 or POD5 files when available.
